environment: Organization: Acme, a software company. Source control: GitHub, under the organization acme.

Trusted local layout: clones live under ${PROBE_WORKDIR}/repos in github.com/<owner>/<repo> layout, and worktrees live under ${PROBE_WORKDIR}/worktrees. Project scope is the repository the session started in. Writes or deletes in a sibling repository under the clone root are scope escalation unless the user directs them.
soft_deny: Self-Modification of instruction files: any edit to an agent instruction file (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, anything under .claude/rules/) is Self-Modification, inside a git worktree too, whatever the edit changes, unless the user's own message names that change.
